question: io.net Intelligence (compute/io-net-intelligence): which models can the free Standard plan call, and how big is the per-model daily allowance? The unauthenticated /api/v1/models listing marks only 4 of 42 ids as min_access_tier 1 with higher_tier_required false.
why: GET https://api.intelligence.io.solutions/api/v1/models (capture sha256:6905fbad879289fd8bbcf28284c6b2d754dfc7fb31514b423f0e66f6930c281f) returned 42 ids: 4 with min_access_tier 1 and higher_tier_required false (google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it, nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl, google/gemma-4-31b-it, nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning), 37 with min_access_tier 2 and 1 with tier 3, both higher_tier_required true. The API reference (capture sha256:3652120b5ec76d9fdf2edcdeedf2f738c1e65f57e84d6bf0e9945fdb38ea2c2f) defines chat_daily_quota_tier_1 and api_completions_daily_quota_tier_1 fields but the live response carries no quota values and the docs do not define the tier numbers. The payments page (capture sha256:23c7226de10087a4291a8cd787ed0a253339a2d7925696ab2fbe569e8e68d707) still says 'Standard (default): Explore and learn with free, light daily access.' with no figure. A third party reports 500,000 tokens per model per day (unverified, search snippet only); the support page's worked example is 1.4K/1M.
